continue_protocol: Read this roadmap, git state and current service/status/completion artifacts. If a stage is still running, report progress and do not start another campaign.
Audit completion counts, failures/retries, input/output hashes, actual target parameters, clipping/escape diagnostics, unique seeds, resource use and source integrity.
Compare results with the frozen stage criteria. Keep diagnostic replays, different models and selection/confirmation cohorts separate. Non-rejection is not equivalence.

Record the result and decision; recompute measured timing and remaining work. If necessary, insert a bounded diagnostic/fix stage with its reason, scope, estimate, cap and success criteria before the dependent production stage.

Implement and test only the next justified stage, freeze its configuration and inputs, and commit scoped code changes locally. Retain validated 1-1000 keV stopping-table bounds. Set per-job timeouts and end-of-session drain allowance from measured longest jobs, verify free disk/RAM, and check the forecast fits the cap. Do not edit a running stage's frozen files; do not push unless requested.

Launch that stage detached within resource and cumulative-time limits. Provide monitoring commands, report path, expected duration and next review instruction. At completion wait for the user's next continue.
A missing scientifically meaningful choice, unsupported bulk-recoil implementation or external calibration requirement needs user direction; do not silently change the scientific question.

stages.title: Pressure and observable/geometry release review

stages.exit_gate: No unexplained critical numerical defect; production observable/model explicitly stated. If an interior-recoil model is required but unavailable, ask for a scientific decision. If a fix/model change is needed, insert C1/C2/C3 before production.

stages.title: Fixed precision follow-up and feature confirmations
stages.scope: Skip additional histories if no precision/confirmation work remains. Otherwise reserve roughly 6-110 hours, using measured variance/timings to freeze an initial 600-ion independent top-up at selected precision failures (200 to 800 total), split into budgeted waves. Keep independent new-cohort precision separate from pooled estimates. Predeclare separate holdout checks for material mixture/pressure features.
stages.exit_gate: Estimated targets met or residual limitations explicitly reviewed. No automatic repeated sampling until significance/precision passes. Forecast is conditional: 10-25% of points needing 600 extra ions at representative grid costs implies roughly 44-110 hours; low-energy-only flags can cost much less.

stages.title: Final integrity audit, analysis and reproducible release
stages.scope: Audit all final raw inputs/results, completeness, model IDs, seeds, hashes, uncertainties and pressure/mixture interpretation. Export PDF plots, CSV points/batches, ROOT, limitations and reproducible commands. Commit code/docs locally; do not push automatically.
stages.exit_gate: User-readable final analysis and complete provenance; no unresolved critical integrity/model issue. Detector-calibrated quenching is explicitly outside what SRIM alone establishes.

contingencies.trigger: Replay mismatch, wrong executed parameters, parser/integral issue, density/pressure discontinuity, clipping or software failure
contingencies.action: Hold dependent production; preserve failing inputs/output; isolate the cause with a bounded fixed-seed reproduction, implement a scoped fix only when justified, add regression tests and rerun fixed canaries. Freeze a new plan rather than editing an active plan.
contingencies.uncertainty: Allowance, not guaranteed resolution time; revise if SRIM internals or unavailable capabilities block diagnosis.

contingencies.trigger: Surface-injection results cannot answer the intended contained-recoil question
contingencies.action: Check documented supported input paths before proposing interior starts. Build and validate a separate geometry/model only if supported; otherwise request user direction on a scoped surface-deposition analysis versus a different simulation approach.
contingencies.uncertainty: Feasibility/validation allowance only. No promise that SRIM supports the required geometry; a different solver is a scope decision.

contingencies.trigger: Accepted geometry or physical model changes
contingencies.action: Use a new model identity; never pool incompatible data. Revalidate representative low/high-energy points, then rebuild required baseline points and recompute all remaining timing/precision estimates.
contingencies.uncertainty: Current-model timing allowance for baseline/release validation, not a bound for a new solver or materially different transport cost.

contingencies.trigger: New non-monotonic mixture feature or pressure effect needing independent confirmation
contingencies.action: Freeze selected points, independent seed set, sample size, effect margins and multiple-testing family BEFORE collecting confirmation; report either outcome. Do not change the endpoint or sample until a p-value passes.
contingencies.uncertainty: Small targeted study allowance. Recompute from selected energies: 1-MeV heavy recoils are much slower than low-energy points.

contingencies.trigger: RAM pressure, OOM, timeout, stall, poor scaling or exhausted time budget
contingencies.action: Stop new submissions, preserve checkpoints, inspect logs, reduce workers or split waves as needed, benchmark again and revise duration. Keep at most 15 cores, RAM limits and zero scan swap; do not bypass caps or alter unrelated applications.
contingencies.uncertainty: Rerun cost of failed/incomplete batches is additional and measured before resume.

done_criteria: The accepted model/geometry and the meaning of range and ionization fraction are explicit; no unresolved critical numerical artifact remains.
All 3024 target points are direct accepted-model results, unless the user explicitly approves a revised scope.
At least four independent 50-ion batches per point; estimated SEM targets and independent confirmation outcomes reported without hiding residual failures.
No legacy/different-model or replay histories contaminate production counts; source/raw/result provenance and seed uniqueness verified.
Final plots, tables, CSV/ROOT exports and reproduction instructions are available; limitations distinguish statistical precision from model accuracy and detector quenching.
